name: What is the process for designing a custom ADU with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing a custom ADU with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our design process for a custom ADU begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, budget, and site-specific considerations. Following this, our team develops conceptual designs, which are refined through collaboration until a final plan is approved. This plan then moves to detailed architectural drawings necessary for permitting. Providing clear feedback and having a general idea of your aesthetic preferences during the initial stages can significantly streamline the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The design process starts with a consultation, moves to conceptual designs, and finishes with detailed architectural plans for permitting.
